days.label: Tuesday
days.text: Tuesday keeps the fair theme going with the Honky Tonk Hoedown at the fair at 7, where Bob Wagner and friends including Mike Gordon, Kat Wright and Brett Hughes soundtrack an attempt at the world's largest square dance, with proceeds benefiting NOFA-VT. Early risers can talk shop at the Tech Breakfast at Zero Gravity from 8 to 10, coffee, waffles & conversation, and singers can try the first week of Flow Singing free at the Heineberg Senior Center at 11:15. In the evening, the Vermont Figure Drawing Collective holds its weekly session at Karma Bird House from 6 to 8 ($20 cash), UK Americana band Brown Horse plays the Higher Ground Showcase Lounge with Eastern Mountain Time, doors at 7:30, and VTIFF screens 'Black Swan' at 7 at Main Street Landing, with local artist KeruBo sharing her new music video and a conversation after the film . Wednesday, our own Pick-up Basketball [MEETUP] runs at Pomeroy Park at 5:30, always free, come get a game in before the rain if the sky cooperates. The rest of Wednesday has range, with coffee with Ben Bosley at Vivid's back tables at 7:30 AM, the AI dev meetup ChatBTV [MEETUP] at Bluehouse Group at 6, Figure 8 Racing criss-crossing the grandstand at 7, Lillian Leadbetter's album release show ($10) at Radio Bean at 7 with Millions of Birds opening, and a free Jenny Porter set at Four Quarters in Winooski at 7:30.

days.label: Thursday
days.text: Thursday is the big night out, weather be warned. The fair's Demolition Derby hits the grandstand at 6:30 with local band Pony Hustle on the bill, grandstand tickets running about $23 in advance. Bark & Brew ($20) returns to the Humane Society in South Burlington from 5:30 to 7:30, two drinks included and dogs welcome in the play yard, with Switchback, Vermont Cider Lab and Lucy & Howe pouring , weather permitting. Blues guitar standout Quinn Sullivan ($30-35) plays the Showcase Lounge with doors at 7:30, and the Strapped-In! queer comedy showcase celebrates its two year anniversary at Vermont Comedy Club at 7 during Pride Week, with a dance party after. Art lovers get two openings, the 'Cut & Sew Show' reception at Karma Bird House Gallery from 6 to 9, where 29 artists reinterpret unfinished chore coats with designer April Cornell, and the Art & Design Summer Research reception at St. Mike's McCarthy Gallery from 6 to 7. VTIFF screens the Lithuanian dramedy 'How to Divorce During the War' at 4 and 7, and Tournesol brings its 1930s Paris cafe jazz to Standing Stone Wines in Winooski at 7, donations at the door. Cyclists can join the Bike Ride @ Pioneer [MEETUP] from Pioneer Lakeshore Cafe in Colchester at 5:30, or cruise into Bike Night at The Old Post in South Burlington from 6 to 8, with food and drink specials plus games and giveaways. Morning people can bring a question to the North District Mayor Meetup at Bagel Cafe & Deli at 8 AM, open to residents from any district. And Sunset Watchers Club may pop up somewhere at sunset this week, they announce the spot a day or two ahead on Instagram , so be sure to catch one of those big bashes before the sunset starts turning too early for it!
